text: chipped off the boulder by you, the diggers and the ram. toss them into the hole: what is in the hole pays for everything.
dug out of the quarry by the miners and carried up to the hole. pays for the arch and the later rungs of every ladder.
grown on the farm and harvested by the farmers. pays for the net, and the apothecary brews with them.
shed by the star when the wizards bolt it apart. the machines' coin: every machine, every rung of their ladders, and the rift.
the deep's coin, crushed out of what the serpent drops.
now and then a hit lands hard, and a fountain of pebbles comes off instead of a chip. the bench sells the chance and the size.
falls out of the sky, one after another. chip it down for pebbles; each new one drives the last back into the ground.
everything you bank lands here, and every bill is paid out of it. it fills up.
torn open over the hole once it was full. it swallows what the hole cannot take, and grows as it eats.
the hole, drowned. bottomless: whatever goes in, there is always room.
dirty rain lands as muck. nobody touches it while the storm is still dropping it; after, the crew shovel it up. muck on a station slows the work there.
everybody has to go sometime. the janitors clean it up.
they cross the sky now and then. click one and it shakes a few pebbles loose.
a room for every body. buy another house to hire somebody; its board is the crew.
every grain dug kicks a mote into the sky, and the machines put up soot. the fuller the sky, the dirtier the rain. only the air filter takes it down.
they drift past at the back. when they swell and darken, rain is coming.
comes when it likes and washes some of the sky down. clean drops just wet the yard; dirty ones land as muck.
comes with a heavy pour. all show: it touches nothing.
a rock in the sky only the wizards can reach. every bit they bolt off sheds sparks; when it is gone they call down the next.
the air filter's craft: it rides up among the clouds and draws the haze in.
hands back some of what the air filter takes out of the sky.
your own board: your click, carry and toss, the haulers' gear, crits, the barriers, and the door to every new place.
the diggers' hut by the boulder. sells their swing and pick, the breaker hat and the ram.
the noticeboard: how long you have played and what the yard earns a second.
plots that grow crops, worked by farmers. sells plots, tending and yield, the grower hat and the tiller.
an open cut; miners work its floor and carry ore up. sells depth, pace and seam, the blaster hat and the drill.
a keeper lights the pot and it brews by itself. the brews walk out to the crew.
summons wizards, a hat each, who fly up to the star. sells the spells, the sphere and the barrier.
no board, just levers. pull the arm and a handful of grains pours down the pegs; the bins they land in pay.
home of the janitors, who clean up the poop and the muck. sells caps and the roombas.
the only thing that empties the sky. air purifiers work it; its dial reads clean, dirty or filthy.
the boulder's machine. bought and tuned with sparks, and it puts up soot.
the quarry's machine. bought and tuned with sparks, and it puts up soot.
the farm's machine. bought and tuned with sparks, and it puts up soot.
carries pebbles from the boulder to the hole with nobody minding it. the haulers tip their loads onto it.
a shell round the star that catches its light and lets it fall as sparks.
little machines that go out from their dock, pick up the mess and bin it.
drives itself to the hole with nobody aboard, and smokes.
the first try at holding off the next boulder. it does not hold.
rope that catches the boulder and lets it down slowly. it does not hold either.
stone that catches one, and then the crack runs.
poured by the wizards, not carried. this one holds.
the water under the drowned hole, where the serpent lives.
conjured by the wizards over the abyss: the way down to the deep.
where the deep's scales are crushed and kept.
the deep's houses: a room for a body down there.
carry pebbles from the ground to the hole. anybody without a job hauls, and they shovel muck too.
swing at the boulder from its row. the shack sells their swing and pick.
work the quarry's floor and bring ore up.
tend the plots and harvest the crops.
work the air filter. only the ones inside it count.
the keeper who lights the pot.
go after the poop first, then the muck.
fly up and bolt the star apart for sparks, and call down a new one. they pour the barrier too.
spare hands lent to put up a building or a machine.
the diggers' hat: twice the bite.
the haulers' cart: twice the load.
the miners' hat: twice the trips.
the farmers' hat: twice the tending.
one for each coin. hearty stew speeds a body up, strong brew makes it stronger, bracing tonic makes it crit.
crew gone down to the deep to fight the serpent, a fighter to a station.
buried by the first boulder. every one you clear, somebody runs to dig; every new one drives them back in.
the line at the top: the story's next step.
the yard's milestones. this sheet keeps the ones you have earned.
